review_reference: Owner decision Q60 of 2026-11-12 ("build the QA tenant / use the mails we used for demo") and the coordinator's answers of the same day (three sides; QoreID, SMS and platform roles kept off; QA email limited to the owner's domain; Patient One pre-shared); to be signed by the owner.
evidence: Migration 0123_sealed_qa_tenant.sql (provisional number) plus its runtime-grants.sql block. WHAT IT DOES: a sealed QA tenant beside the real tenants and 0098's sealed demo, for the owner's own end-to-end testing; every QA login does every real action, and nothing crosses between the three sides (real, demo, QA). New owner-only table identity.sealed_qa_members (RLS enabled, not forced, one owner policy, no grant, immutable); helpers sealed_qa_ids, sealed_qa_facility (EXECUTE for hid_identity_runtime and hid_schema_test_runtime, which the registration-read policy calls as the reader), sealed_qa_patient, sealed_qa_account, sealed_qa_recipient (the owner's domain @healthidentitydirectory.com, plus-addresses allowed) and the seed sealed_qa_install (owner only). SEAL: nine new BEFORE triggers beside 0098's, which keep their bodies: G1q consent grants and G2q staff memberships both QA or neither; G3q no platform role for a QA account; G4q a QA patient's share invitation to the owner's domain only and accepted on its side only; G5q no QA patient phone (no SMS); G6q no QoreID quota (no paid lookup); G7q a QA patient's emergency contact only an email the check recorded; G8q an outreach group whose organiser is a QA account is QA (name starting "QA "); G9q a QA outreach group invites the owner's domain only; and a member is never both demo and QA. Nine bodies replaced, each 0098's byte for byte (md5-pinned in the preconditions) plus one QA clause beside its demo clause, always true for real and demo rows: create_access_request, activate_break_glass, access_patient_with_pin, ehr.send_order_route, search_order_destinations, search_share_providers, start_my_email_change, admin_platform_overview (QA not counted) and sealed_demo_contact_allowed (a QA branch before the demo branch, which is unchanged); identity.patients' policy patients_registration_read gets the same QA clause beside 0098's. DEMO PATIENT LOGINS MOVE (owner, 2026-11-12): patient1@ and patient2@ were 0098's demo patient logins, so in the same transaction, before the QA seed, demo_patient_logins_move (owner only) moves the two demo patient accounts to patientdemo1@ and patientdemo2@ (address, updated_at and row_version only; password, sessions, status, verification, Health IDs, shares and seal kept; one count-only audit row; refuses with 55000 a new address held by an account, staff record, open application or pending staff invitation, a demo login on neither address, or a demo patient's live email emergency contact or pending share invitation to an old address, so nothing of the demo still points at a QA mailbox; a second call moves nothing); 0098's exact allowlist sealed_demo_recipient and seed sealed_demo_install are replaced with the new addresses (md5-pinned before and after). SEED: on Amazon RDS only (rds_superuser), as 0098: QA Hospital, QA Laboratory, QA Pharmacy (the latter two with an approved admin_review application and product), seven staff logins (one mailbox of the owner's domain per role: ehr@, migrate@, lab@, lab2@, pharmacy@, admin@, outreach@) and two patient logins (patient1@, patient2@), pending_reset, no password, email verified; QA Patient One shares with the QA clinician at QA Hospital (grant, share row, a migration audit row); Health IDs HID-ZQAAAAA2 and HID-ZQAAAAA3. Refuses (55000, nothing written) when an address, id, slug, code, Health ID or CAC is held by someone else. Identity's generator never issues a code starting ZQA or ZDEM. KNOWN LIMITS (coordinator-accepted): no new login invited into QA and no new QA patient; QA Outreach is started by its organiser login through the normal flow. BACKWARD COMPATIBLE: real behaviour unchanged and demo behaviour unchanged but for the two demo patient addresses (every new clause is true for non-QA rows; the full sealed-demo suite passes; its pins of the eight bodies and records-processing's pin of create_access_request are updated to the new bodies). LOCKS: SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE NOWAIT (5 s bound) on the ten tables that get a trigger, ACCESS EXCLUSIVE NOWAIT on identity.patients for the policy, last. TESTS: services/ehr-api/test/database/sealed-qa-tenant.integration.sql (structure, install and its refusals, every direction between real, demo and QA, the QA-only rules, the platform overview, the outreach group, overlap) and every existing database suite.
